house_style: Sophisticated editorial gouache illustration for a Grade 10 chemistry bakery. Rich tactile brushed texture, realistic proportions, warm honey wood, cream marble, brushed steel and amber highlights. Light from upper left. Beautiful detailed materials and soft shading. No text, letters, numbers, logos, border or people.

assets.name: mb-counter
assets.prompt: Wide cozy small bakery interior in early morning. Honey wood counter top and flour-dusted marble across foreground. Plain dark green blank chalkboard on back wall, empty glass display case. Warm window light from left, deep atmospheric layers, copper and wood details. Open clear counter space in the middle for interactive equipment.

assets.name: mb-scale
assets.prompt: Small flat digital kitchen scale in brushed stainless steel, front three-quarter view almost straight on. A broad plain blank dark display centered on its front. Fine screws, brushed edges and soft highlights. Entire object alone on perfectly flat pure green #00FF00 background, no ground shadow.

assets.name: mb-bowl
assets.prompt: Wide empty clear glass mixing bowl seen directly from the side, broad elliptical rim and rounded foot. Sparse delicate reflections only, allowing moving particles to show through. Entire object alone, no ground shadow.
